from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    when, col,concat, substring_index, expr, concat_ws, lit, to_date, split,to_date, date_format
)
from datetime import datetime

from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number

# get the previous quarter
today = datetime.today()
fy = today.year + 1 if today.month >= 7 else today.year
fq = ((today.month - 1) // 3) -1

fyq_prefix = f"FY{str(fy)[-2:]}Q{fq}"

print(fyq_prefix)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# fyq = "FY25Q1"

df_main = (
    df_cpe b 
    .filter(F.col("TAMPERIOD").startswith(fyq_prefix))
    .filter(F.col("PRIORITY").isin("0", "1"))
    .filter(F.col("MSPN") != "")

    # for all 4 regions
    .filter(F.col("REGION").isin("APAC", "EMEA", "LATAM", "AMER"))
    .filter(F.col("BOMEXPLODED") == 0)
    .filter(F.col("COUNTRY").isNull())

    .select(
        F.col("REGION"),

        # SINAME logic:
        F.when(F.col("SINAME") == "WORLD WIDE TECHNOLOGY INC", F.lit("WWT"))
         .when(F.instr(F.col("SINAME"), " ") == 0, F.col("SINAME"))
         .otherwise(F.upper(F.split(F.col("SINAME"), " ").getItem(0)))
         .alias("SINAME"),

        F.col("PFAM"),
        F.col("PFAMMSF"),
        F.col("MSPN"),
        F.col("COSTCATEGORY"),
        F.col("PARTCATEGORY"),
        F.col("ITEMDESCRIPTION"),
        F.upper(F.col("MFGNAME")).alias("MFGNAME"),

        # QTY logic
        F.when(F.col("ITEMDESCRIPTION").like("Ops Model%"), F.lit(1))
         .otherwise(F.col("QTY"))
         .alias("QTY"),

        F.col("UNITPRICE"),
        F.col("NETAMOUNT"),
        F.col("SERVICECOST"),

        # TOTAL_RACKPRICE logic
        F.when(
            (F.col("COSTCATEGORY") == "SI MANAGED") & (F.col("UNITPRICE") == 0),
            F.col("SERVICECOST")
        ).when(
            (F.col("COSTCATEGORY") == "SI MANAGED") & (F.col("UNITPRICE") > 0),
            F.col("UNITPRICE")
        ).otherwise(F.col("NETAMOUNT") + F.col("SERVICECOST"))
         .alias("TOTAL_RACKPRICE"),

        F.col("TAMPERIOD"),
        F.col("RECORDID"),
        F.col("VERSION"),
        F.col("ISPUBLISHED"),
        F.col("ISLATEST")
    )
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_msf = Window.partitionBy("PFAM", "SINAME").orderBy(F.col("PFAMMSF").desc())
w_ver = Window.partitionBy("PFAM", "PFAMMSF", "SINAME").orderBy(F.col("VERSION").desc())

published_maxVer = (
    df_main
    .filter(F.col("ISLATEST") == 1)
    .withColumn("UID", F.upper(F.concat(F.col("SINAME"), F.col("PFAM"))))
    .withColumn("rank_MSF", F.dense_rank().over(w_msf))
    .filter(F.col("rank_MSF") == 1)
    .withColumn("rank_Ver", F.dense_rank().over(w_ver))
    .filter(F.col("rank_Ver") == 1)
)

unpublished_maxVer = (
    df_main
    .filter(F.col("ISLATEST") == 0)
    .withColumn("UID", F.upper(F.concat(F.col("SINAME"), F.col("PFAM"))))
    .withColumn("rank_MSF", F.dense_rank().over(w_msf))
    .filter(F.col("rank_MSF") == 1)
    .withColumn("rank_Ver", F.dense_rank().over(w_ver))
    .filter(F.col("rank_Ver") == 1)
)

tran_df = (
    published_maxVer.select(*df_main.columns, "UID")
    .unionByName(
        unpublished_maxVer.join(
            published_maxVer.select("UID").distinct(), on="UID", how="left_anti"
        ).select(*df_main.columns, "UID"),
        allowMissingColumns=True
    )
)

#final df
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

final_df = (
    tran_df
    .filter((F.col("MSPN").isNotNull()) & (F.length(F.col("MSPN")) > 0))
    .select(
        F.col("PFAM").alias("PlatformName"),
        F.col("PFAM"),
        F.col("COSTCATEGORY").alias("CostType"),
        F.lit(None).alias("Assembly"),
        F.col("PARTCATEGORY").alias("PartType"),
        F.lit(None).alias("ShortDesc"),
        F.col("ITEMDESCRIPTION").alias("Description"),
        F.col("SINAME").alias("Vendor"),
        F.lit(None).alias("Capacity"),
        F.col("QTY").cast("int").alias("NoPerRack"),
        F.col("UNITPRICE").cast("double").alias("UnitCost"),
        F.col("TOTAL_RACKPRICE").cast("double").alias("RackPRICE"),
        F.substring(F.col("TAMPERIOD"), 1, 6).alias("Quarter"),
        F.col("REGION").alias("region"),
        F.col("MSPN"),
        F.col("MFGNAME").alias("oemMFG"),
        F.lit(0).alias("UnitPRICERebate"),
        F.lit(0).alias("RackPRICERebate"),
        F.lit(0).alias("SPrice"),
        F.col("TOTAL_RACKPRICE").cast("double").alias("RPrice"),
        F.lit(0).alias("shouldcost"),
        F.lit(0).alias("ServersPerRack"),
        F.current_timestamp().alias("DateSubmitted")
    )
)
